title: Clark Freifeld: 'Discover how the best interests of the shareholders AREN'T the best interests of the shareholders'
summary: LTSE investor and software engineer Clark Freifeld pushes preorders with a punchy preview of two of the book's central provocations — paradoxical shareholder interests, and how to do the right thing without getting sued or fired. Eric reposts.
blockquote:
Friends: Get your grubby mitts on a preorder of Eric Ries's new book, Incorruptible. He's already changed your life once with his seminal 2011 book The Lean Startup. Prepare to be changed again. Discover how the best interests of the shareholders AREN'T the best interests of the shareholders. Discover how to not get sued or fired for doing the right thing. Seriously, get this book. It's coming out May 26th.

Disclosure: I'm a proud investor in the Long-Term Stock Exchange, a place for public companies that aligns shareholder interests with long-term interests.
attribution_title: Senior Software Engineer at NewGrid; LTSE Investor
